
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Samhu07/p/19787417" title="发布于 2026-03-28 14:54">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">ABC450G 题解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>本做法为随机化做法，思路是<a href="https://atcoder.jp/contests/abc447/editorial/16741" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">这篇题解</a></p>
<p><a href="https://atcoder.jp/contests/abc447/tasks/abc447_g" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">题目链接</a></p>
<p>记选的 <span class="math inline">\(6\)</span> 个题目为 <span class="math inline">\(k_{1/2/3/4/5/6}\)</span>。</p>
<p>首先我们将题目类型随机赋值为 <span class="math inline">\(0/1/2/3\)</span>，显然原来不合法的方案在随机赋值之后仍然不合法，而实际上的最优解在现在仍然合法的概率为 $\frac{3}{256} $。</p>
<p>证明：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><span class="math inline">\(k_3\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(k_4\)</span> 不相同的概率为 <span class="math inline">\(\frac{3}{4}\)</span>，因为 <span class="math inline">\(k_3\)</span> 可以随便取，之后 <span class="math inline">\(k_4\)</span> 的值只能在 <span class="math inline">\(0/1/2/3\)</span> 中挑除了 <span class="math inline">\(k_3\)</span> 以外剩下的 <span class="math inline">\(3\)</span> 个。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>固定 <span class="math inline">\(k_3\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(k_4\)</span> 之后，<span class="math inline">\(k_{1/2/3/4}\)</span> 互不相同的概率为 <span class="math inline">\(\frac{1}{4} \times \frac{2}{4}=\frac{1}{8}\)</span>，因为 <span class="math inline">\(k_1\)</span> 可以挑 <span class="math inline">\(4\)</span> 个中的 <span class="math inline">\(2\)</span> 个，<span class="math inline">\(k_2\)</span> 只能挑 <span class="math inline">\(4\)</span> 个中的 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 个。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>同理 <span class="math inline">\(k_{3/4/5/6}\)</span> 互不相同的概率也为 <span class="math inline">\(\frac{1}{8}\)</span>。总概率为 <span class="math inline">\(\frac{3}{4} \times \frac{1}{8}\times \frac{1}{8}=\frac{3}{256}\)</span>。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>这样我们就将题目类型数缩减到了 <span class="math inline">\(4\)</span>。设随机赋值后新的题目类型为 <span class="math inline">\(g_i\)</span>。</p>
<p>接下来我们维护以下信息</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[pre_{i,j}= \max\limits_{1\le k \le i \bigwedge g_k=j}a_k
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[suf_{i,j}= \max\limits_{i\le k \le n \bigwedge g_k=j}a_k
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[s_{i,j} = a_i+\sum_{k\in \left \{ 0,1,2,3 \right \} \bigwedge k \ne g_i \bigwedge k \ne j}suf_{i+1,k} 
\]</div><p></p><p></p><div class="math display">\[t_{i,j,k} = \max\limits_{i \le sufi \le n \bigwedge g_{sufi} = j} s_{sufi,k}
\]</div><p></p><p>我们枚举第三个题目的位置 <span class="math inline">\(i\)</span>，与第四个题目的类型 <span class="math inline">\(j\)</span>。</p>
<p>那么此时的答案为</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[a_i + t_{i+1,j,g_i} + \sum_{k\in \left \{ 0,1,2,3 \right \} \bigwedge k \ne g_i \bigwedge k \ne j} pre_{i-1,k}
\]</div><p></p><p>这样我们以 <span class="math inline">\(O(n)\)</span> 的时间复杂度解决了问题。</p>
<p>接着我们随机赋值 <span class="math inline">\(600\)</span> 次，那么错误率为 <span class="math inline">\((1-\frac{3}{256})^{600} \approx 8 \times 10^{-4}\)</span>。可以接受。</p>
<p>实测 <span class="math inline">\(T = 300\)</span> 时 WA 两个点， <span class="math inline">\(T = 500\)</span> 时可以通过。</p>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include&lt;cmath&gt;
#include&lt;cstdio&gt;
#include&lt;cstring&gt;
#include&lt;iostream&gt;
#include&lt;algorithm&gt;
#include&lt;ctime&gt;
#include&lt;random&gt;
#define mp make_pair
#define fo(i , x , y) for(int i = x ; i &lt;= y ; i++)
#define go(i , x , y) for(int i = x ; i &gt;= y ; i--)
using namespace std;
mt19937 rd(time(0));
const int maxn = 100000;
const long long inf = 100000000000;
int n , k[maxn + 5];
long long a[maxn + 5] , f[maxn + 5] , g[maxn + 5];
long long pre[maxn + 5][4] , suf[maxn + 5][4] , s[maxn + 5][4] , t[maxn + 5][4][4];
long long solve(){
    fo(i , 1 , n) f[i] = rand() % 4;
    fo(i , 1 , n) g[i] = f[k[i]];
    //--------------------
    fo(j , 0 , 3) pre[0][j] = -inf;
    fo(i , 1 , n){
        fo(j , 0 , 3){
            pre[i][j] = pre[i - 1][j];
            if(g[i] == j) pre[i][j] = max(pre[i][j] , a[i]);
        }
    }
    //--------------------
    fo(j , 0 , 3) suf[n + 1][j] = -inf;
    go(i , n , 1){
        fo(j , 0 , 3){
            suf[i][j] = suf[i + 1][j];
            if(g[i] == j) suf[i][j] = max(suf[i][j] , a[i]);
        }
    }
    //--------------------
    fo(i , 1 , n){
        fo(j , 0 , 3){
            s[i][j] = a[i];
            fo(k , 0 , 3){
                if(k == j or k == g[i]) continue;
                s[i][j] += suf[i + 1][k];
            }
        }
    }
    //--------------------
    fo(j , 0 , 3)
        fo(k , 0 , 3)
            t[n + 1][j][k] = -inf;
    go(i , n , 1){
        fo(j , 0 , 3)
            fo(k , 0 , 3) t[i][j][k] = t[i + 1][j][k];
        int j = g[i];
        fo(k , 0 , 3)
            t[i][j][k] = max(t[i][j][k] , s[i][k]);
    }
    //--------------------
    long long ans = -inf;
    fo(i , 3 , n - 3){
        fo(j , 0 , 3){
            if(g[i] == j) continue;
            long long cur = t[i + 1][j][g[i]] + a[i];
            fo(k , 0 , 3){
                if(k == g[i] or k == j) continue;
                cur += pre[i - 1][k];
            }
            ans = max(ans , cur);
        }
    }
    return ans;
}
int main(){
    // ios :: sync_with_stdio(0) , cin.tie(0) , cout.tie(0);
    // freopen(".in" , "r" , stdin);
    // freopen(".out" , "w" , stdout);
    cin &gt;&gt; n;
    fo(i , 1 , n) cin &gt;&gt; k[i] &gt;&gt; a[i];
    long long ans = -inf;
    ans = solve();
    fo(i , 1 , 300) ans = max(ans , solve());
    if(ans &lt; 0) cout &lt;&lt; "-1\n";
    else cout &lt;&lt; ans &lt;&lt; "\n";
}
</code></pre>


</div>
